empty.title: Nothing to analyse yet
empty.body: Record a transaction and this page fills in with allocation, performance, contribution and trade statistics.

performance.title: Performance
performance.hint: Portfolio value against invested capital. Deposits raise both lines, so they never look like a return.

allocation.title: Allocation
allocation.hint: Stocks and cash as a share of total value.

concentration.title: Concentration
concentration.hint: Informational only — Stockly describes your portfolio, it does not advise on it.

contribution.title: P&L contribution
contribution.hint: What each holding contributed, split into booked and on-paper profit.

trades.hint: A trade is one sell. Break-even trades are excluded from the win rate.

fees.title: Fees
fees.hint: What trading has cost, in money rather than in feel.

dividends.title: Dividend income
dividends.hint: Two yields with two denominators — they are not interchangeable.

attribution.title: What produced this return
attribution.methodHint: Money-weighted: each holding measured against the money actually in it.

unavailable.NO_BEGINNING_VALUE: No valuation was recorded at the start of this period, so there is nothing to measure the change against.
unavailable.NO_ENDING_VALUE: No valuation was recorded at the end of this period.
unavailable.EMPTY_PERIOD: The portfolio held nothing during this period.
unavailable.NO_HISTORICAL_FX: Separating currency movement from asset performance needs an exchange rate for every day of the period, and Stockly does not store one for all of them.

contribution.incomplete: {symbol} could not be measured for this period.
contribution.added: {symbol} added {points} percentage points ({amount} {currency}) of the portfolio's return.
contribution.removed: {symbol} removed {points} percentage points ({amount} {currency}) of the portfolio's return.
